citationText: P. Debevere, D. Van Deursen, E. Mannens, R. Van de Walle, K. Braeckman, and R. De Sutter, “Medialoep: Optimizing Search in a Broadcaster Archive,” Proc. 12th International Workshop on Image Analysis for Multimedia Interactive Services, Delft, The Netherlands, Apr. 2011. First presented at IBC 2014, Amsterdam, The Netherlands, 11-15 September 2014. This paper is published here by kind permission of the IBC. Copyright © IBC. THE AUTHORS Marieke Lycke studied electrical engineering (multimedia & signal processing) at the Katholieke Universiteit (KU) Leuven, Belgium. In 2012 she started as a researcher in VRTs Research & Innovation department where she specializes in media, mostly audio, analysis tools. She was involved in projects about employing speech and language technology in workflows for different kinds of media users: from journalist, archivist to end user. She is also a member of the EBU SCAIE group.
